body: Started Milestone 1 (generalize the clone/drag-select mechanism off Tyler-only) and found by checking every real gate directly that it's already hero-agnostic -- only the spawn trigger and one sizing constant are Tyler-specific, both needing a real second hero's kit numbers to generalize correctly. Milestone 1 collapses into Milestone 2. Also fixed a mis-citation (HERO_CONTENT_FRAMEWORK.md is GoblinFoxDragon's, not this roster's -- the real pipeline is §7/TYLER/multiverse_heroes.md). Commit 114d542.
title: NORTHSTAR §24 correction: Milestone 1 already done, found not built
